_units: Combined arms A8 (cg_brief queue item 2.6; docs/combined_arms.md 2.2.2, 2.4.5, 2.9, 9.2, 9.3): logistics and armour packages, read by VehicleLogistics (scripts/vehicles/vehicle_logistics.gd) and MotorPool. Every number is Proposed. Seconds, metres, tonnes, litres. rearm: rounds as items (data/items.json: stats.shell names the data/shells.json round, per_item the rounds an item holds, stow_s the hand time to stow one through the cargo point into the right rack, 2.9.2: 10 s a 120 mm round, 15 s a link box, 30 s a TOW, 10 s a smoke salvo); stopped_mps: the vehicle at most this fast; from an ammo carrier (another vehicle's hold: the HEMTT stand-in) within carrier_reach_m at carrier_mult x hand speed; from a pallet (an ammo pallet item on the ground or in the vehicle's own hold) within pallet_reach_m at pallet_mult. heli_load: the helicopter resupply's armour ammo, by calibre (2.9.2: 8 x 120 mm or 300 x 25 mm or 2 TOW), shortest first. fuel: refuelling from a fuel pallet (drums, hand pump) or a tanker model (tankers: none in vehicles.json yet; the M978's 9,500 L at 300 L/min when D6a adds it) within reach_m. repair: the field table (2.2.2 and 2.9.3) by module kind, each job [item, seconds with two men, the states it fixes] plus to (the health after; field_to by default) and solo_x (one man alone takes this many times as long; solo_x by default); helper_m: a second able man on foot within this of the worker (or an able crewman aboard) makes two; a job pauses while its worker is suppressed (suppression over suppressed, or fire at him within threat_pause_s) or the vehicle was hit within hit_pause_s, and stops (its progress kept on the module) if he moves job_move_m or the vehicle does; tiles: an ERA tile or slat panel back from the spares (40 s); fob_only: kinds only the motor pool fixes. tow (2.8.3's stand-in for a recovery vehicle: no M88 in data): a tower of at least min_mass_share of the towed vehicle's mass, hitches within hook_m, hooked up in hook_s by a man at the towed vehicle's service point, both stopped; the bar bar_m long, stiff k_per_kg N/m per kg of the towed vehicle, damped; the pair at most max_kmh. packages (2.4.5): fit_days and remove_days at the motor pool (default by package, days), refund (a removed package's share back), upgrade_credit (fitting a package that includes one already fitted credits that one's price). extinguishers (2.10.1, F-262's bottles): halon (the crew compartment's automatic shot) and engine (the manual engine-bay shots) per model; refilled at the FOB at refill_price each. models: per model (merged into its spec as logistics): loadouts, the FOB load-outs the motor pool page picks from ({rack module id: {shell id: rounds}}; standard is data/vehicle_weapons.json's racks). The tow hitches are the hull boxes' front and back ends, 0.5 m up.
